newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Von Roll unit gets 66 mln Sfr Swedish order.
newsitem.headline: Von Roll unit gets 66 mln Sfr Swedish order.

text.p: A unit of Swiss engineering group Von Roll Holding AG said it was awarded an order worth 66 million Swiss francs ($43 million) to build an energy plant in Sweden fuelled by household garbage and other waste.

The order, for its Svenska Von Roll AB unit, includes planning, delivery, installation and start-up of a combined energy and heating plant fuelled by household garbage, wooden rubbish, construction waste and other recyclables.

Von Roll, which last year sold its Swiss steel interests, has focused on engineering and considers itself a technology group. It has recently received orders for similar plants in Germany and Czechoslovakia.
The latest contract was awarded by Umea Energi AG, Von Roll said. The new plant is scheduled to begin operation in autumn 1999. ($ = 1.526 Swiss Francs)
